senses.gloss: m. (denom. of מוּג; cmp. מוֹהַל) pus, tenacious matter.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 48a:14">Ḥull. 48ᵃ</cite> <he>מליא מ׳</he> if the abscess in the kidneys is full of matter, opp. <he>מים זכים</he>.

<cite ref="Yevamot 75b:1">Yeb. 75ᵇ</cite> <he>ונפק מיניה כחוט דמ׳ וכ׳</he> (Ar. <he>ונפק מיניה מ׳</he>) and there came out of the wound something like a thread of pus, and yet he begot children afterwards.
